semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset; at a rising edge with reset=1 q becomes 5-bit value 1.
semantics.transition: Right-shifting Galois LFSR: q_next[4]=q[0], q_next[3]=q[4], q_next[2]=q[3] XOR q[0], q_next[1]=q[2], q_next[0]=q[1]. Tap positions 5 and 3 refer to one-based positions, corresponding to q[4] and q[2].
semantics.initialization: Original problem does not specify power-up state; no initialization is added and functional sequence checks begin after synchronous reset.
semantics.hold: No state change between rising clock edges, including reset assertions.

numeric.zero_state: Never reached in the reset-seeded sequence.

verification.oracle: From original right-shifting Galois description: shift previous state right then XOR mask 10100 if previous LSB is 1.
verification.sampling: Check held output before rising edges and compare after a delay allowing nonblocking assignments to settle.
directed_cases: Held reset over multiple rising edges
Full 31-state nonzero unique cycle and return to seed
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation timeout and fatal mismatches; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Only synchronous reset value is specified.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No guarantee before first reset edge; testbench does not require a particular power-up value.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Five-bit register has taps at positions 5 and 3, so positions use one-based indexing.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use q[4] and q[2] as feedback destinations.
